entities.name: Antanas Tumėnas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antanas Tumėnas was a Lithuanian politician, teacher, professor of law, judge, 8th Prime Minister of Lithuania, and Chairman of the Supreme Committee for the Liberation of Lithuania. He was a member of the Lithuanian Christian Democratic Party.
